summary: Authors FigJam board content — emits a node list (sticky notes, text, shapes, sections, connectors, stamps) that the renderer draws onto a target FigJam board.
in_scope: Shape nodes (ellipse, rounded rectangle, diamond, hexagon, pentagon, star, arrow, chevron, flowchart shapes)
Section nodes that group other nodes
Connector edges between nodes, optionally labeled
out_of_scope: Figma design-file authoring (frames, components, variants) — use the Figma MCP for design-file work
Auto-layout — renderer takes coordinates literally; plan positions explicitly
Host-app embedding or sync to FigJam — handled by the renderer
